about: FIX-2 (docs/decisions.md D-P6-FIX2-1/-2): every J5 side of the v1 baseline cells 1500:BLITZ and 1600:BLITZ whose Elo is 1550-1649 (the players the 1600 band centre is made of), as J5 journalled them: real rated Lichess games of lichess_db_standard_rated_2026-10 (CC0), graded with the pinned Stockfish 18 (sf18-v1) and the worker's input builder. Game ids replaced by ordinals (no ids, names or dates); accuracy values rounded to 0.01. Used to measure the weakness eligibility test's false-positive rate on band-average members and its power on members with a real excess.
